This template is to be used for all [https://www.ilm.com ilm.com] webpages. For [https://www.ilmxlab.com ilmxlab.com], use {{Tl|ILMxLAB}} instead.

==Usage==
Copy the template code below, and paste it into an article's reference note. Fill in as many parameters as you can, remove any that you don't use.

<code><nowiki>{{ILM|url=|text=|archivedate=|archiveurl=|nobackup=}}</nowiki></code>

===Required parameters===
*{{Para|url}} URL of the web page, minus the domain name (<code><nowiki>https://www.ilm.com/</nowiki></code>).
*{{Para|text}} Name of the page being cited.

{{BackupLinkHelp}}

==Examples==
<code><nowiki>{{ILM|url=disney-gallery-the-mandalorian-takes-viewers-behind-the-scenes-of-the-hit-series|text='DISNEY GALLERY: THE MANDALORIAN' TAKES VIEWERS BEHIND THE SCENES OF THE HIT SERIES}}</nowiki></code>

*{{ILM|url=disney-gallery-the-mandalorian-takes-viewers-behind-the-scenes-of-the-hit-series|text='DISNEY GALLERY: THE MANDALORIAN' TAKES VIEWERS BEHIND THE SCENES OF THE HIT SERIES}}
